The '''Augmentation shop''' was a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] establishment operating on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> It was located within the [[Coronet Boulevard]] on the moon, and guarded by a few thugs from the [[Krayts]] who had purchased goods from there. [[Ekayn Liistot]] and [[Sabaya Liistot]] managed the shop and sold goods such as cybernetic implants, spice, genetic modifications and stims, with the help of several employees. Numerous homeless [[Evocii]] frequented the shop.

==Behind the scenes==
The Augmentation shop appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
